mapper.select: SELECT model, count(*) AS n FROM device WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY model

SELECT c.code AS "code", c.name AS "name", count(rc.resource_id) AS "devices" FROM capability c LEFT JOIN resource_capability rc ON rc.capability_id = c.id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{param1} GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name ORDER BY "devices" DESC, c.code
SELECT DISTINCT dm.method FROM device_method dm JOIN capability c ON c.id = dm.capability_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{param1} AND c.code = #{param2} ORDER BY dm.method
